semantic_models.name: sem_web_sessions
semantic_models.description: Session grain model. Bounce/duration/pageviews from v_session_bounce; exit_page derived from page views; is_online_flag = active in last 5 minutes.

measures.name: online_visitor_count
measures.expr: case when is_online_flag = 1 then visitor_id end

measures.name: new_visitor_sessions
measures.expr: case when is_first_session_flag = 1 then visitor_id end

measures.name: returning_visitor_sessions
measures.expr: case when is_first_session_flag = 0 then visitor_id end

semantic_models.name: sem_web_visitors
semantic_models.description: Visitor 360 profile model with lifetime activity, loyalty, and identification status.

measures.name: lifetime_new_visitor_flag_count
measures.expr: case when is_returning_visitor = 0 then visitor_id end

measures.name: lifetime_returning_visitor_flag_count
measures.expr: case when is_returning_visitor = 1 then visitor_id end

measures.name: identified_visitors
measures.expr: case when is_identified_flag = 1 then visitor_id end

semantic_models.name: sem_page_views
semantic_models.description: Page load event model for content dwell time and reading scroll depth.

semantic_models.name: sem_interaction_events
semantic_models.description: Interaction event model for click heatmaps, rage clicks, and dead clicks.

measures.name: total_clicks
measures.expr: case when event_type = 'click' then event_id end

measures.name: rage_clicks
measures.expr: case when event_type = 'rage_click' then event_id end

measures.name: dead_clicks
measures.expr: case when event_type = 'dead_click' then event_id end

semantic_models.name: sem_form_events
semantic_models.description: Form funnel event model for views, starts, submits, successes, and abandons.

measures.name: form_views
measures.expr: case when event_type = 'form_view' then event_id end

measures.name: form_starts
measures.expr: case when event_type = 'form_start' then event_id end

measures.name: form_submits
measures.expr: case when event_type = 'form_submit' then event_id end

measures.name: form_successes
measures.expr: case when event_type = 'form_success' then event_id end

measures.name: form_failures
measures.expr: case when event_type = 'form_failure' then event_id end

measures.name: form_abandons
measures.expr: case when event_type = 'form_abandon' then event_id end

semantic_models.name: sem_conversion_events
semantic_models.description: Monetary conversion and goal completion model.

measures.name: purchases
measures.expr: case when conversion_type = 'purchase' then conversion_id end

measures.name: signups
measures.expr: case when conversion_type = 'signup' then conversion_id end

measures.name: checkout_starts
measures.expr: case when conversion_type = 'begin_checkout' then conversion_id end

measures.name: cart_adds
measures.expr: case when conversion_type = 'add_to_cart' then conversion_id end

semantic_models.name: sem_product_interactions
semantic_models.description: Ecommerce product interaction and browsing model.

semantic_models.name: sem_performance_events
semantic_models.description: Core Web Vitals and frontend rendering timing model.

measures.name: poor_vitals_count
measures.expr: case when rating = 'poor' then event_id end

measures.name: avg_lcp_value
measures.expr: case when metric_name = 'LCP' then metric_value end

measures.name: avg_fcp_value
measures.expr: case when metric_name = 'FCP' then metric_value end

measures.name: avg_cls_value
measures.expr: case when metric_name = 'CLS' then metric_value end

measures.name: avg_inp_value
measures.expr: case when metric_name = 'INP' then metric_value end

measures.name: avg_ttfb_value
measures.expr: case when metric_name = 'TTFB' then metric_value end

semantic_models.name: sem_error_events
semantic_models.description: Frontend JavaScript exception and resource error model.

semantic_models.name: sem_cookie_operations
semantic_models.description: Cookie consent and audit trail model.

measures.name: consent_granted_count
measures.expr: case when action = 'consent_granted' then event_id end

measures.name: consent_denied_count
measures.expr: case when action = 'consent_denied' then event_id end

semantic_models.name: sem_replay_chunks
semantic_models.description: Session replay chunk index and recording model.

semantic_models.name: sem_custom_events
semantic_models.description: Arbitrary business events dispatched via WebtualAnalytics.track(), sliceable by event_name. Enables full 360 coverage for custom conversions/funnels beyond the built-in event types (site_search, etc.).

semantic_models.name: sem_known_users
semantic_models.description: Authenticated user ↔ visitor identity mappings (email, phone, traits) from dim_known_users.

semantic_models.name: sem_ecommerce_daily
semantic_models.description: Daily e-commerce rollup from ecommerce view (product funnel + purchases + revenue).

metrics.name: web_session_volume
metrics.description: Total number of distinct browsing sessions initiated on tracked websites.
metrics.label: Web Session Volume

metrics.name: unique_visitors
metrics.description: Distinct visitors from sessions (uniqExact visitor_id on dim_sessions grain) — never count() rows.
metrics.label: Unique Visitors

metrics.name: page_views
metrics.description: Total count of individual page load events.
metrics.label: Page Views

metrics.name: average_session_duration
metrics.description: Average activity-span session duration in seconds from v_session_bounce (not dim_sessions.duration_seconds).
metrics.label: Average Session Duration

metrics.name: pages_per_session
metrics.description: Average number of page views loaded per browsing session.
metrics.label: Pages per Session

metrics.name: bounce_count
metrics.description: Sessions with exactly 1 pageview AND activity-span duration < 10s (v_session_bounce only).
metrics.label: Bounce Count

metrics.name: bounce_rate
metrics.description: Bounce sessions / sessions from v_session_bounce (1 pageview AND duration < 10s). Never dim_sessions.is_bounce.
metrics.label: Bounce Rate

metrics.name: online_visitors
metrics.description: Distinct visitors with session activity in the last 5 minutes (greatest(updated_at, coalesce(ended_at, updated_at))).
metrics.label: Online Visitors

metrics.name: engaged_session_count
metrics.description: Sessions that are not bounces per v_session_bounce (inverse of bounce).
metrics.label: Engaged Session Count

metrics.name: engagement_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions that are not bounces (1 - bounce_rate).
metrics.label: Engagement Rate

metrics.name: total_events
metrics.description: Total count of captured interaction events.
metrics.label: Total Events

metrics.name: events_per_session
metrics.description: Average count of captured events per session.
metrics.label: Events per Session

metrics.name: new_visitor_count
metrics.description: Period new visitors: visitors with exactly 1 session in the filtered window (SQL templates). This MF measure uses is_first_session_flag (lifetime first-ever) as a fallback approximation only — prefer SQL template path.
metrics.label: New Visitor Count

metrics.name: returning_visitor_count
metrics.description: Period returning visitors: visitors with >1 session in the filtered window (SQL templates). MF measure uses non-first-ever sessions as approximation only.
metrics.label: Returning Visitor Count

metrics.name: new_visitor_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of unique visitors in the period who are first-time visitors.
metrics.label: New Visitor Rate

metrics.name: returning_visitor_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of unique visitors in the period who have visited more than once.
metrics.label: Returning Visitor Rate

metrics.name: lifetime_new_visitor_count
metrics.description: As-of-now count of visitors whose lifetime session total is still 1 (i.e. have never returned). NOT period-scoped — reflects current visitor state regardless of date filter. Use new_visitor_count for period-based reporting.
metrics.label: Lifetime New Visitor Count (profile snapshot)

metrics.name: lifetime_returning_visitor_count
metrics.description: As-of-now count of visitors whose lifetime session total is 2+. NOT period-scoped — reflects current visitor state regardless of date filter. Use returning_visitor_count for period-based reporting.
metrics.label: Lifetime Returning Visitor Count (profile snapshot)

metrics.name: identified_visitor_count
metrics.description: Count of visitors resolved to a known user_id via identify() or login.
metrics.label: Identified Visitor Count

metrics.name: visitor_identification_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of unique visitors resolved to a known user_id.
metrics.label: Visitor Identification Rate

metrics.name: identified_session_count
metrics.description: Count of browsing sessions linked to a known user_id or Worktual Campaign contact_id.
metrics.label: Identified Session Count

metrics.name: identified_session_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions linked to a known user_id or Worktual Campaign contact_id.
metrics.label: Identified Session Rate

metrics.name: campaign_attributed_sessions
metrics.description: Count of sessions arriving via marketing UTM parameters or Worktual Campaign tracking links.
metrics.label: Campaign Attributed Sessions

metrics.name: campaign_attributed_session_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of total sessions driven by marketing campaigns.
metrics.label: Campaign Attributed Session Rate

metrics.name: landing_page_conversion_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions entering through a specific page that completed a conversion goal.
metrics.label: Landing Page Conversion Rate

metrics.name: total_clicks
metrics.description: Total count of click interactions captured on site elements.
metrics.label: Total Clicks

metrics.name: clicks_per_session
metrics.description: Average number of user clicks performed per session.
metrics.label: Clicks per Session

metrics.name: rage_clicks
metrics.description: Total rapid, repeated click clusters on the same element within a short timeframe.
metrics.label: Rage Click Count

metrics.name: rage_click_session_count
metrics.description: Count of browsing sessions that experienced at least one rage click incident.
metrics.label: Sessions with Rage Clicks

metrics.name: rage_click_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions experiencing rage click incidents.
metrics.label: Rage Click Rate

metrics.name: dead_clicks
metrics.description: Total clicks registered on non-interactive elements producing no DOM action.
metrics.label: Dead Click Count

metrics.name: dead_click_session_count
metrics.description: Count of browsing sessions that experienced at least one dead click.
metrics.label: Sessions with Dead Clicks

metrics.name: dead_click_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions with at least one dead click (not dead_clicks/total_clicks).
metrics.label: Dead Click Rate

metrics.name: avg_scroll_depth
metrics.description: Mean maximum vertical scroll depth percentage reached per page view.
metrics.label: Average Scroll Depth

metrics.name: sessions_with_deep_scroll
metrics.description: Count of sessions reaching at least 50% vertical scroll depth.
metrics.label: Sessions with Deep Scroll

metrics.name: scroll_engagement_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions reaching at least 50% vertical scroll depth.
metrics.label: Scroll Engagement Rate

metrics.name: avg_time_on_page_seconds
metrics.description: Average duration in seconds visitors spend actively viewing a specific page.
metrics.label: Average Time on Page

metrics.name: form_views
metrics.description: Count of times a tracked form became visible in the visitor's viewport.
metrics.label: Form Views

metrics.name: form_starts
metrics.description: Count of initial user interactions with a form.
metrics.label: Form Starts

metrics.name: form_submits
metrics.description: Total attempts to submit a completed form.
metrics.label: Form Submits

metrics.name: form_successes
metrics.description: Count of form submissions that succeeded without validation or server error.
metrics.label: Form Successes

metrics.name: form_failures
metrics.description: Count of form submission attempts rejected due to validation errors or server failures.
metrics.label: Form Failures

metrics.name: form_abandons
metrics.description: Count of forms that were viewed or started but left without submitting.
metrics.label: Form Abandons

metrics.name: form_submit_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of form views that result in a submission attempt.
metrics.label: Form Submit Rate

metrics.name: form_success_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of form submissions that successfully succeed without errors.
metrics.label: Form Success Rate

metrics.name: form_abandon_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of started forms that are abandoned before completing submission.
metrics.label: Form Abandon Rate

metrics.name: total_conversions
metrics.description: Total count of successful business conversions completed on site.
metrics.label: Total Conversions

metrics.name: sessions_with_conversions
metrics.description: Count of browsing sessions that achieve at least one conversion goal.
metrics.label: Sessions with Conversions

metrics.name: conversion_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of browsing sessions that achieve at least one conversion goal.
metrics.label: Conversion Rate

metrics.name: total_revenue
metrics.description: Sum of monetary transaction value across completed conversion events.
metrics.label: Total Revenue

metrics.name: total_conversion_value
metrics.description: Alias of total_revenue — sum(value) on fact_conversion_events.
metrics.label: Total Conversion Value

metrics.name: purchase_count
metrics.description: Total count of completed purchase conversion events.
metrics.label: Purchase Count

metrics.name: average_order_value
metrics.description: Average monetary revenue generated per completed purchase order.
metrics.label: Average Order Value

metrics.name: signup_count
metrics.description: Total count of completed user registration or signup conversions.
metrics.label: Signup Count

metrics.name: checkout_start_count
metrics.description: Count of conversion events with conversion_type = 'begin_checkout'.
metrics.label: Checkout Start Count

metrics.name: sessions_with_checkout_start
metrics.description: Count of sessions that initiate the checkout process.
metrics.label: Sessions with Checkout Start

metrics.name: checkout_start_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions that initiate the checkout process.
metrics.label: Checkout Start Rate

metrics.name: checkout_conversion_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of initiated checkouts that successfully result in a completed purchase.
metrics.label: Checkout Conversion Rate

metrics.name: cart_add_count
metrics.description: Count of times products were added to a shopping cart.
metrics.label: Cart Add Count

metrics.name: sessions_with_cart_add
metrics.description: Count of sessions containing at least one add-to-cart interaction.
metrics.label: Sessions with Cart Add

metrics.name: cart_add_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of sessions containing at least one add-to-cart interaction.
metrics.label: Cart Add Rate

metrics.name: product_interaction_count
metrics.description: Total count of product impressions, views, and clicks recorded.
metrics.label: Product Interaction Count

metrics.name: sessions_with_product_views
metrics.description: Count of browsing sessions that view at least one product.
metrics.label: Sessions with Product Views

metrics.name: product_view_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of browsing sessions that view at least one product.
metrics.label: Product View Rate

metrics.name: avg_lcp_ms
metrics.description: Average Largest Contentful Paint metric in milliseconds.
metrics.label: Average Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)

metrics.name: avg_fcp_ms
metrics.description: Average First Contentful Paint metric in milliseconds.
metrics.label: Average First Contentful Paint (FCP)

metrics.name: avg_cls
metrics.description: Average Cumulative Layout Shift score measuring visual stability.
metrics.label: Average Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)

metrics.name: avg_inp_ms
metrics.description: Average Interaction to Next Paint responsiveness latency in milliseconds.
metrics.label: Average Interaction to Next Paint (INP)

metrics.name: avg_ttfb_ms
metrics.description: Average Time to First Byte in milliseconds.
metrics.label: Average Time to First Byte (TTFB)

metrics.name: poor_vitals_event_count
metrics.description: Count of Web Vitals metric events flagged with rating = 'poor'.
metrics.label: Poor Web Vitals Event Count

metrics.name: performance_event_count
metrics.description: Total count of Core Web Vitals and performance measurement events.
metrics.label: Performance Event Count

metrics.name: poor_vitals_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of captured Core Web Vitals measurements rated as poor.
metrics.label: Poor Web Vitals Rate

metrics.name: error_count
metrics.description: Total count of uncaught JavaScript and network resource errors.
metrics.label: Total Frontend Errors

metrics.name: error_session_count
metrics.description: Count of browsing sessions that encountered one or more frontend JavaScript errors.
metrics.label: Sessions with Errors

metrics.name: error_session_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of browsing sessions impacted by client-side errors.
metrics.label: Error Session Rate

metrics.name: tracking_consent_granted_count
metrics.description: Count of cookie consent audit records where action = 'consent_granted'.
metrics.label: Tracking Consent Granted Count

metrics.name: tracking_consent_denied_count
metrics.description: Count of cookie consent audit records where action = 'consent_denied'.
metrics.label: Tracking Consent Denied Count

metrics.name: consent_action_count
metrics.description: Total count of cookie consent audit records.
metrics.label: Consent Action Count

metrics.name: tracking_consent_grant_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of captured consent interactions where tracking consent was granted.
metrics.label: Tracking Consent Grant Rate

metrics.name: search_session_count
metrics.description: Count of browsing sessions that triggered a site_search custom event.
metrics.label: Sessions with Search

metrics.name: search_usage_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of browsing sessions that performed an internal site search.
metrics.label: Search Usage Rate

metrics.name: total_custom_events
metrics.description: Total count of all custom business events dispatched via WebtualAnalytics.track(), across every event_name.
metrics.label: Total Custom Events

metrics.name: distinct_custom_event_types
metrics.description: Count of distinct event_name values seen in the period. Use with an event_name group-by/filter to analyze any individual custom event (funnels, feature usage, etc.) beyond the built-in event types.
metrics.label: Distinct Custom Event Types

metrics.name: custom_event_session_count
metrics.description: Count of distinct sessions that triggered at least one custom event. Filter/group by event_name for a specific event's session reach.
metrics.label: Sessions with Any Custom Event

metrics.name: custom_event_session_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of browsing sessions that triggered at least one custom event. Filter/group by event_name for a specific event's adoption rate.
metrics.label: Custom Event Session Rate
